source.title: Example: J1939 PGN field layout, one record per upstream file
source.publisher: Example Layout Publisher; layout per SAE J1939-71

fields.name: Suspect Parameter Number
fields.description: The SPN value itself is carried in this field; no separate SPN number applies.

notes: Field values are copied verbatim from the upstream file; the SPN number is only ever read out of the upstream 'name'/'description' text, never inferred (the validator WARNs when it is not mentioned there). Records in data/intake/pgn/ are staged for review and are NOT merged into data/diagnostics/canboat_pgn_reference.json.
